title: HOT ROAD
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Kazuki, a 14-year-old girl who feels unloved by her single mother, drifts away from being a 'good girl' and meets Haruyama, a reckless member of a 1980s motorcycle gang. The two lonely, misunderstood teens are drawn together in a moody shoujo coming-of-age drama about family neglect, delinquency and first love.
life_message: Lonely young people need to be seen and loved, and love can pull them back from self-destruction.
